original_test_intent: Measure valid STREAM Copy/Scale/Add/Triad host-memory bandwidth under a reproducible profile and compare it with an equivalent platform reference.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Download stream.c, compile with OpenMP, double, array size 430080000 and NTIMES=100, then run `./stream`.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Suggested build/run but mislabeled the result scope.
historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED; preserved fixed macros and separated internal iterations from complete-run repetition.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer approves source/compiler, OpenMP/NUMA profile and comparable baseline; build, run and parsing are automatable.
required_user_inputs: Thread, affinity and NUMA first-touch profile

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Array size 430080000, NTIMES=100 and original compile command are retained; times are planning references.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Changed macros or scope require an explicit project coverage comparison; DIMM theoretical rate is not equivalent to STREAM bandwidth.

original_method: Retain the exact source compile macros and STREAM numerical validation output.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use approved STREAM source/build through an existing project benchmark harness when it preserves flags, topology binding and full output.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record source hash, compiler/OpenMP and OS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: STREAM official source/documentation; project reference supplies acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Adds reproducible binding, provenance, repetitions and comparison contract.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction of four kernels or numerical validation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong first-touch/affinity, swapping or insufficient array headroom invalidates results.

safety_boundaries: No unverified source, swap-driven run or production contention.
Stop on validation, ECC/MCE, thermal/power or stability limits.
expected_evidence: Exact environment and four kernel outputs
no_automatic_retry: Invalid numerical output or profile is retained; no affinity/tuning change and rerun without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent calculates under the approved contract; engineer owns the formal result.
review_improvement: V3.1 keeps V3 because missing DIMM SPEC is a required project input, not permanent BLOCKED, while retaining the exact source profile and comparison boundary.
